# Christian Bodenbender

> Backend software engineer based in Marburg, Germany. 7 years of experience building data-intensive IoT platforms, real-time analytics engines, and cloud-native data lake pipelines. Available for full-time hybrid or remote roles.

## About

Christian Bodenbender is a backend engineer who has spent the last seven years working on high-scale industrial IoT infrastructure. His most recent work involves Cumulocity DataHub — an IoT analytics platform processing roughly 3 billion messages per day from over 25 million connected industrial devices, recognised in the Gartner Magic Quadrant 2025.

He is equally comfortable establishing process in fast-moving startup environments and operating within structured international R&D teams. He also has a dog.

## Skills & Technologies

- **Languages:** Java (primary, 7+ years production), Kotlin, Python, Go, C/C89
- **Streaming & messaging:** Apache Kafka, Vert.x
- **Data & analytics:** Apache Parquet, Dremio, S3, Azure Data Lake, SQL
- **Observability:** Grafana (custom integrations), SLI/SLA enforcement
- **Infrastructure:** Docker, Kubernetes (early adopter)
- **Security:** CVE management (proactive, same-day patching), pentesting fundamentals, SQL injection hardening, SLI/SLA enforcement
- **Domains:** IoT platforms, real-time analytics, data lake pipelines, payment systems, voice products, fleet monitoring

## Experience

- **Software Engineer, IoT R&D — Cumulocity GmbH** (Aug 2022 – present): Cumulocity DataHub. 3B messages/day, 25M devices, S3 and Azure Data Lake, Apache Parquet, Dremio SQL layer, BI integrations (Power BI, Tableau).
- **Software Engineer, IoT R&D — Software AG** (Jan 2022 – Jul 2024): Analytics components for Cumulocity DataHub. Data lake pipelines and historical time series analysis for AI/ML workflows.
- **Software Developer — Tallence AG** (Apr 2019 – Jan 2022): Multi-stack client projects including payment interfaces, insurance systems, IoT fleet monitoring with custom Grafana, and voice product THOR.
- **Working Student, IoT Analytics — Software AG** (Aug 2017 – Mar 2019): Real-time IoT analytics in Java and Vert.x. Early Docker and Kubernetes adoption.
- **Student Assistant — Philipps-Universität Marburg** (Oct 2015 – Aug 2017): Eclipse Henshin, rule-based model transformation for Eclipse Modeling Framework.
- **Part-time Developer — Weclapp** (Apr 2012 – Jul 2013): E2E test framework with WebDriver. Features implementation.

## Education

- **B.Sc. Computer Science** — Technische Hochschule Mittelhessen (2016–2019), grade 2.0. Coursework included pentesting and low-level C89 systems engineering.

Full-time. Hybrid or fully remote. Preferred stack: Java, Kotlin, Python, Go — open to others.
